summary: Travis Boyle, 41, of Union, Kentucky, died in an unroped ~200-foot bouldering fall on Christiana Peak near Capitol Peak when a rock hold flaked off; his companion, stranded on a cliff band, was lowered to safety
responding_agency: Pitkin County Sheriff's Office; Mountain Rescue Aspen
notes: Boyle and companion were bouldering without ropes at about 12,751 feet. Call received about 5:45 p.m. Monday; body taken out of the backcountry by 3:20 p.m. Tuesday, September 29.
